analysis_md:

$\operatorname{rot}A=\begin{vmatrix}\vec{\mathbf i}&\vec{\mathbf j}&\vec{\mathbf k}\\\frac{\partial}{\partial x}&\frac{\partial}{\partial y}&\frac{\partial}{\partial z}\\xe^{yz}&ye^{zx}&ze^{xy}\end{vmatrix}=\{xze^{zx}-xye^{xy},xye^{xy}-yze^{yz},yze^{yz}-xze^{zx}\}$
